Karnataka Minister's Religion Remark Sparks Political Row

Karnataka Higher Education Minister Basavaraj Rayareddi stated that Islam is a greater religion than others and that everyone should visit mosques. This statement has triggered a strong backlash from the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). The BJP has demanded an apology from Rayareddi and his resignation, accusing him of having an "anti-Hindu mindset" and engaging in "vote bank politics." The Congress party, to which Rayareddi belongs, is facing criticism over the remark.
